name: Amoz
title: The father of the prophet Isaiah
summary: Amoz (Hebrew: Amots) is known as the father of the prophet Isaiah, one of the major prophets in the Old Testament. Little is known about his own life beyond his role as Isaiah's father. He should not be confused with the prophet Amos, despite the similarity in names.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Isaiah's father
keyEvents.description: Amoz is identified as the father of the prophet Isaiah in the opening verse of the book of Isaiah, which places the prophet's ministry during the reigns of kings Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Isaiah's call and Amoz's lineage
keyEvents.description: When Isaiah receives his calling vision in the temple, he is again identified as the son of Amoz, which underscores his family background.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in connection with Isaiah's prophecy to King Ahaz
keyEvents.description: In the account of Isaiah's meeting with King Ahaz during the Syro-Ephraimite War, the prophet is identified as the son of Amoz.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy against Babylon
keyEvents.description: In the prophecy about the fall of Babylon, Isaiah is again referred to as the son of Amoz, confirming his family line.

keyEvents.title: Referred to in 2 Kings
keyEvents.description: Amoz is mentioned as Isaiah's father in connection with the prophet's ministry during King Hezekiah's reign, when the Assyrian king Sennacherib threatened Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in 2 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In the account of the reigns of kings Uzziah and Hezekiah in the books of Chronicles, Isaiah is identified as the son of Amoz.
